_note: #150 editorial picks, chosen by looking at the approved photos. Media by seedKey, projects by photo-cluster key, categories by TR slug, FAQ by TR category slug + index into its seed FAQ. Loader: scripts/seed/editorial.ts (fills only empty fields). The owner can change any of this in the admin.

hero.reason: Finished garden terrace deck with railing built around a mature tree: a complete outdoor job, sharp, landscape; the small watermark sits on the boards left of the tree, not on the subject.

mobileHero.reason: Portrait stepped iroko deck under a tree with a pergola behind: the deck, tree and pergola fill the upper half the phone shows clear of the text; only lawn and stepping stones sit under the H1. The watermark (mid-frame on every portrait) falls on the deck edge, not on the text.

featuredProjects.reason: Slatted pergola, wall cladding and outdoor kitchen on a terrace: the most finished, design-led outdoor job; wide cover shows the whole space.
Large terrace deck, cross railings, stair and roofed kamelya on a seaside slope: shows scale and several services in one job.
Curved iroko seating bench in a garden: bespoke workshop craft, clean recent photo.
Cross-railed outdoor stair with a landing from the lawn to a villa's upper level: the whole stair in frame; a different photo from the Merdivenler cover.
Garden deck at a villa's glass doors: the typical homeowner job, warm finished boards on lawn.
Oiled deck with metal railing at a garden edge: recent photo, completes a row of three on desktop.

sundurma-ve-ahsap-cati.reason: Timber cabin on a stone base with lawn: the whole building reads in a 21:9 crop.

deck-ve-zeminler.reason: Ground-floor garden deck with flower boxes and seating, 2560 px wide, small watermark; replaces the stacked-watermark header.

pergola-ve-kamelyalar.reason: Pergola over a deck with cross railings above a planted stone wall, single watermark; the other wide pergola shots carry stacked watermarks.

korkuluk-ve-cit.reason: White picket fence and gate on a stone wall in front of a house: the whole run reads in a 21:9 crop, 1600 px, only a faint single-line mark on the pickets (#156: replaces the picket fence whose two-line mark crossed the frame).

ciceklik-ve-oturma-grubu.reason: Terrace planters around a deck with a Bosphorus view, 3264 px wide.

kapi-dolap-ve-seperator.reason: Slatted outdoor storage cabinet, finished and front-on, 2560 px wide.

ireko-teak.reason: Warm-toned hardwood deck laid around a topiary tree and box hedges: crisp, no camera stamp, watermark beside the tree; not a frame of any featured project's cover.

mobilya-ve-cila.reason: Finished office with a wooden desk and wall unit: tidy, lit, the furniture is the subject.

boya-tamir-ve-bakim.reason: Pressure-washing a deck in a garden: says maintenance at a glance, bright; replaces the dim close-up.

faq.reason: Pine or iroko: the first question most deck enquiries ask.
Deck over an existing concrete or tiled terrace: common for villas and flats.
Pergola or kamelya: the second-biggest service, a real decision question.
How often to oil a deck: aftercare.
Maintenance of decks built by another company: widens who can call.
Who does the work: own workshop and own crew, true for every service.

swaps._note: #156: covers re-picked for lighter watermarks (seedKeys). scripts/seed/editorial-swaps.ts replaces a cover only while the database still holds `from` (exact id); for a project `from: null` also needs the first gallery photo to still be `firstPhoto` (the hero the page computes). Guide keys are seed/content/guides file names, whose `cover` already names `to` for new databases. projectCategories: category links the photos clearly show (key: photo-cluster key), appended after the seeded category, never reordered, and only while a project still has exactly `from`.
